title: 第19章 破纪录第20章 名声响彻宗内
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
就在那一瞬间，傀儡仿佛被注入了无穷的力量一般，骤然启动。
它抬起手中紧握着的利剑，猛地一挥，一道璀璨夺目的剑光如闪电般疾射而出。
说时迟那时快，陆玄合毫不示弱，同样挥舞起手中的斩仙剑，刹那间，另一道凌厉的剑光呼啸着划过半空。
只听得“当”
的一声巨响，两道剑光在空中猛烈碰撞，迸发出耀眼的光芒和震耳欲聋的爆炸声。
紧接着，陆玄合趁势反手挥出一道更为强大的剑气，直冲向傀儡。
然而，这傀儡身形敏捷地一闪，轻而易举地躲过了陆玄合的攻击，并以惊人的速度朝着陆玄合身侧疾驰而来。
“好！
唯有如此强劲之敌，方能逼出我的全部实力！
今日就让我来瞧瞧自己的极限究竟在何处！”
见此情形，陆玄合眼中闪过一丝兴奋之色，大声喝道
话音未落，他右手紧紧握住剑柄，毫不犹豫地迎着朝他猛扑过来的傀儡冲了上去。
一时间，密室之中响起一连串密集而沉闷的撞击声——“砰！
砰！
砰！”
一人一傀的剑光相互交织、纵横交错，每一次碰撞都如同星辰炸裂，威势骇人，空间竟然隐隐有破碎之意。
他们的身影在虚空中急速穿梭，令人眼花缭乱。
此刻的陆玄合已然完全沉浸在了这场激烈无比的战斗之中，忘却了一切。
尽管他身上那些刚刚愈合的伤口因为剧烈的动作再度崩裂开来，但他对于剑道的感悟却在这生死搏杀之间不断加深。
渐渐地，他体内潜藏已久的禁忌剑体被彻底激发出来，虚空中弥漫着冰冷刺骨的凛冽剑意以及复杂深奥的剑道规则。

......
另一边，九阳洞内。
赵凡与陆玄合一同来到试炼峰后，彼此分别前往适合自己的历练场所。
陆玄合是剑修，自然前往剑楼。
而他，则径直走向了闻名遐迩的九阳洞。
这九阳洞，可是道极宗内所有修炼火属性功法的弟子心目中的圣地。
因为这里蕴藏着诸多深奥玄妙的火属性规则大道，每一条都蕴含着无尽的奥秘等待着人们去探索和领悟。
然而，最为令人称道的是，九阳洞内设有一座神秘无比的阵法。
这座阵法拥有着神奇的力量，能够引发深藏于九阳洞地下的强大火属性灵脉。
当阵法启动之时，灵脉中的磅礴能量便会被源源不断地激发出来，进而召唤出一头头由纯粹的火焰规则凝聚而成的火灵兽。
这些火灵兽宛如燃烧的精灵一般，周身散发着炽热的火焰光芒。
它们虽然不会说话，但是对于火属性规则的理解超乎常人。
进入九阳洞的弟子与之对战，能有巨大的磨练效果。
也只有道极宗这样财大气粗的东荒域巨擘，才有实力用一条火属性灵脉来布置成试炼秘境供门下弟子试炼之用。
content_en:
At that moment, the puppet suddenly activated as if it was injected with infinite power.
It raised the sword tightly in its hand and swung it violently, and a dazzling sword light shot out like lightning.
As soon as it was said, Lu Xuanhe showed no sign of weakness and also waved the Immortal Killing Sword in his hand. In an instant, another sharp sword light roared across the air.
Just listen "appropriately"
With a loud noise, the two sword lights collided violently in the air, bursting out with dazzling light and deafening explosions.
Immediately afterwards, Lu Xuanhe took advantage of the situation and waved a more powerful sword energy with his backhand, rushing straight towards the puppet.
However, the puppet dodged nimbly, easily dodging Lu Xuanhe's attack, and galloped towards Lu Xuanhe's side at an astonishing speed.
"Okay!
Only such a powerful enemy can force out my full strength!
Today let me see where my limits are! "
Seeing this situation, Lu Xuanhe's eyes flashed with excitement and he shouted loudly
Before he finished speaking, he grasped the hilt of the sword tightly with his right hand and rushed forward without hesitation to face the puppet that rushed toward him.
For a moment, a series of dense and dull collisions sounded in the secret room - "Bang!
Bang!
Bang! "
The sword lights of one person and one puppet are intertwined and criss-crossed. Every collision is like a star exploding. The power is terrifying, and the space is faintly broken.
Their figures shuttled rapidly through the void, making it dizzying.
At this moment, Lu Xuanhe was completely immersed in this fierce battle and forgot everything.
Although the newly healed wounds on his body cracked open again due to the violent movements, his understanding of the way of the sword continued to deepen during this life-and-death fight.
Gradually, the forbidden sword body that had been hidden in his body for a long time was completely aroused, and the void was filled with the cold and biting sword intent and the complex and profound rules of the sword.
...
On the other side, inside Jiuyang Cave.
After Zhao Fan and Lu Xuanhe came to the Trial Peak together, they went to the training places suitable for themselves.
Lu Xuanhe was a sword cultivator, so he naturally went to the sword tower.
And he went straight to the famous Jiuyang Cave.
This Jiuyang Cave is a holy place in the eyes of all the disciples who practice fire attribute skills in Daoji Sect.
Because there are many profound and mysterious avenues of fire attribute rules here, each of which contains endless mysteries waiting for people to explore and understand.
However, the most commendable thing is that there is an extremely mysterious formation in Jiuyang Cave.
This formation possesses magical power and can trigger powerful fire-attribute spiritual veins hidden deep underground in Jiuyang Cave.
When the formation is activated, the majestic energy in the spiritual veins will be continuously stimulated, and then summon fire beasts that are condensed from pure flame rules.
These fire spirit beasts are like burning elves, with blazing flames radiating from their bodies.
Although they cannot speak, their understanding of the rules of fire attributes is beyond ordinary people.
Disciples who enter Jiuyang Cave and fight against it can have a huge training effect.
Only Daoji Sect, a wealthy giant in the Eastern Wasteland, has the strength to use a fire-attribute spiritual vein to create a secret trial realm for the disciples to use for trials.
